Third-party code served from this folder, unmodified apart from removed
sourcemap comments and unused build variants. paddleocr and onnxruntime-web
are copied from node_modules, and the models downloaded, at build time:

paddleocr (paddleocr.js) 1.2.0  MIT  paddleocr/paddleocr.mjs (Copyright (c) x3zvawq; licence declared in its package.json, which ships no licence file)
onnxruntime-web 1.30.0     MIT         onnxruntime/ (Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation)
PP-OCRv6 models            Apache-2.0  paddleocr/PP-OCRv6_tiny/ (PaddlePaddle; added at build time, see paddleocr/MODELS.md)
pdfjs-dist 6.4.299         Apache-2.0  pdfjs/
qrcode-generator 2.0.4     MIT         qrcode/ (Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase)

Licence texts are in each folder where the package included one.
